# VoltEdge Strategy

## Vision
VoltEdge Devices aims to be the leading US supplier of rugged payment terminals, focused on reliability and fast turnaround.

## Target Customer (ICP)
- Segment: mid-size US retailers and ISOs deploying 100-5,000 payment terminals
- Profile: operations-led buyers; value uptime, fast RMA turnaround, predictable supply
- Pain points:
  - Field failures causing checkout downtime
  - Slow repair turnaround from current vendors
  - Customs/tariff surprises on imported hardware

## 2026 Goals
- Units shipped: 30,000 (currently 21,000 run-rate)
- Field return rate: < 3% annualized (currently 2.8%)
- Supplier on-time delivery: > 95%
